department: Institute of Computer Science (Faculty of Science)

deadline.value: Doctoral applications at the University of Bern are accepted throughout the year once a thesis supervisor agrees (fall semester registration runs September 1 to October 15).
deadline.quote: You can apply to do a doctorate throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A confirmed supervisor at Bern must be in place before admission; the confirmation of supervision is filled in for every doctorate.
supervisor.quote: Fill in the confirmation of supervision that applies to your doctorate.

also.quote: A doctorate is carried out in close collaboration with a supervisor from the Institute of Computer Science
Interested persons can contact a leader of a research group directly

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule for admitted PhD students.

entry_route.value: A master's or licentiate from a Swiss university or ETH, or an equivalent degree, is needed for doctoral admission.
entry_route.quote: hold a master's degree or a licentiate from a Swiss university or Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, or an equivalent university degree

name: Doctoral Degree Program in Computer Science
